messages:
Nora (CS): FYI Pegasus renewal in 12 days. They want 9mo, 30 seats, SSO. Procurement insists on PO + delegated signer evidence. Can we align on pricing and sign flow?
Chris AE: They asked for 11% off. I can approve up to 7% if legal confirms signer proof and ops can accept PO.
Raj Ops: PO ok. Tell them to include billing entity (US/EU) on PO. We can create vendor code VND-9601.
Ivy Legal: For delegated signer we need an email from CFO or an authorizing memo. Also verify corporate email domain. No T&C edits requested so far?
Nora (CS): Customer wants standard T&Cs plus explicit EU residency line. Procurement will send CFO email and PO template.
Chris AE: I'll offer 7% if they sign within 48h; otherwise standard rate.
Raj Ops: Draft invoice below, please confirm seats and line items.
```
Invoice draft:
Customer: Pegasus Labs
Term: 9 months
Seats: 30
List price: $81,000
Discount 7% -> $75,330
Billing: Net30
Line items: seats, SSO, onboarding
PO: pending
```
Nora (CS): Seat count confirmed. Proc uploaded PO template requesting separate line items. CFO email incoming.
DocuSign Bot: Envelope created env_PG9601. Recipient: signer@pegasus.com. Status: sent.
Ivy Legal: When CFO email arrives save to contract folder and note delegated signer in agreement.
Nora (CS): Signed via DocuSign at 2024-06-25T13:40Z (env_PG9601). CFO email forwarded to legal.
DocuSign Bot: Envelope env_PG9601 status: completed. Signed at 2024-06-25T13:40Z.
Raj Ops: PO uploaded PO-PG-990 referencing VND-9601. Invoice issued for $75,330 net30.
Chris AE: Marked renewal closed in CRM: 9mo, 30 seats, 7% discount.
Nora (CS): Closing loop 14 onboarding kickoff scheduled next Wed 11am PT. Thanks team!
